meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 给这个基于 Claude 的 agent 装上后，它在回答前会自动翻阅过去存入的相关内容，并把每轮中的新信息记下来。这些记忆保存在容器挂载的目录里，容器重启后依然存在。
howto.when: 每次对话、它作答前都会自动触发记忆检索，每轮结束后再保存新的内容；该能力仅在 agent 使用默认 Claude provider 时生效。

say.text: 我们上次聊到要在报告中加入数据图表，现在继续吧。
say.note: 它会检索记忆并接着上次的内容继续。

say.text: 我之前提到过一个重要的截止日期，你还记得吗？
say.note: 它会从记忆里找出那个截止日期。

say.text: 请按照我们之前约定的语气写这段文字。
say.note: 它会查找之前约定的语气并应用。

howto.what_en: After installation, the agent recalls relevant past memories before it responds and stores new insights after each turn. Memory is kept in a persistent mount, so it survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: On every conversation with an agent using the default Claude provider, it recalls relevant memories before responding and saves new insights after each turn.

say_en.text: We talked about adding data charts to the report—let's continue.
say_en.note: It fetches memory to pick up where you left off.

say_en.text: I mentioned an important deadline earlier—do you remember it?
say_en.note: It looks up the stored deadline from memory.

say_en.text: Please write this paragraph in the tone we agreed on earlier.
say_en.note: It finds the agreed tone in memory and applies it.
